title: Font Manager Unicode block table
description: The Unicode blocks, copied from Blocks.txt of the Unicode Character Database. The glyph map groups a face's characters by these blocks.

unicodeVersion.description: The Unicode version the table comes from (17.0.0).

source.description: The URL of the Blocks.txt file the table was copied from.

blocks.description: Every block, sorted by first code point. Blocks do not overlap.

codePoint.description: A code point in upper-case hex, 4 to 6 digits, at most 10FFFF.

assigned.description: Code points of the block whose General_Category is not Cn (unassigned), from DerivedGeneralCategory.txt of the same version. At most the block's size.

name.description: The block name as Blocks.txt writes it (Latin Extended-A). Unique.
